title: Woman Cook on Stepladder, Rustic Log Cabin - Antique 1920s Sepia Snapshot Photo
description: A woman dressed in a crisp white cook or camp uniform with a matching cap sits casually atop a wooden stepladder leaning against the exterior of a rustic log building. Behind her, the structure features rounded log walls, a prominent fieldstone chimney, and a small shingled dormer. Cooking pots or pitchers rest on the wide windowsill, suggesting the cabin may have functioned as a camp kitchen or mountain retreat lodge during the 1920s.
